motivation: The frozen rainfall-timescale analysis showed elevated active richness through days 4–7 versus >=8-day runs, while matched recent-vs-dry net richness was no longer clearly positive at days 4–7. The unopened question is whether compositional turnover at days 4–7 remains elevated above ordinary dry-vs-dry year-to-year turnover.
ecological_question: After the short-lived richness expansion wanes, does a rainfall pulse leave a detectable compositional memory in the acoustically active frog assemblage?

source.runs: Reuse complete 10-stop, temperature-qualified NAAMP runs from NAAMP_ECOLOGICAL_PULSE_CONTRACT_V0_1.json.
source.species_sets: CallingIndex 1–3 presence anywhere in the 10-stop run.

pairing.rule: Sort eligible runs by SurveyYear and pair adjacent observed years, exactly as in the ecological-pulse analysis.
eligible_pair_classes: day0/day1/days2_3/days4_7: exactly one member is <8 days and the other is >=8 days; class is the recent member's bin
pairing.ignored: Pairs with both members <8 days or equal classification outside the specified dry-dry comparison.

primary_endpoint.response: Simpson turnover between the two active species sets
primary_endpoint.model: simpson_turnover ~ C(pair_class, Treatment(reference='dry_dry')) + abs_temp_difference + abs_doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber)
primary_endpoint.hypothesis: If active-community composition retains a rainfall memory after richness expansion weakens, turnover at 4–7 days should exceed dry-dry background turnover.

secondary_endpoints.sorensen: Same model using Sørensen dissimilarity; supportive only.
secondary_endpoints.discordant_species_count: Same model using b+c, the total number of species present in only one member; supportive only.
secondary_endpoints.recent_minus_dry_richness: For recent-vs-dry pairs only, estimate adjusted mean richness_recent - richness_dry by recent bin using signed temp/doy differences, year gap, State and RunNumber. This describes expansion decay but is not the primary memory test.

sensitivity.exact_consecutive_year: Repeat all primary/secondary models using year_gap=1 only.
sensitivity.no_rescue: Sensitivity cannot rescue a failed primary endpoint.

interpretation.supported_memory: Primary days4_7 turnover contrast >0 with 95% CI excluding 0 supports compositional memory beyond dry-dry temporal background.
interpretation.two_phase_language: Use 'two-phase pulse' only if days4_7 turnover exceeds dry-dry background and the adjusted days4_7 recent-minus-dry richness CI includes 0 in the same analysis family. This is descriptive phase separation, not a formal changepoint.
interpretation.unsupported: If days4_7 turnover does not exceed dry-dry background, retain the one-week richness timescale but do not claim compositional memory.

boundaries: Dry-dry turnover is background temporal turnover of acoustically active assemblages, not occupancy turnover.
This is a post-opening follow-up motivated by the already-opened timescale curve; only the dry-dry background contrast is newly unopened.
No new rain-recency cutpoints are allowed.
No causal rainfall, colonization, extinction, or breeding-success claim.
